text: minervini: "RANGE, no pivot cleared." Granted. My for-line overstated it: the range has not resolved yet. Buying the top edge of a range is fading the wrong edge (C11), and I do not do it. My SUPPORT is conditional on the breakout only: a daily close above pivot_high on a top-third close with volume >= 1.2x, a sign-of-strength (C5, C12). If that never prints, nothing triggers. If it is rejected at the range top and closes back under vwap_14d, I drop it. Until then it is a range, and it needs a breakout to be a trade.
